content: उचित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Fit, proper, right, suitable; उचितस्तदुपालम्भः <ls>U. 3</ls>; usually with <ab>inf.</ab>; उचितं न ते मङ्गलकाले रोदितुम् <ls>Ś. 4</ls>. .²2 Usual, customary; उचितेषु करणीयेषु <ls>Ś. 4. 7. 12</ls>; <ls>K. 64</ls>; <ls>M. 3. 3</ls>. .²3 Accustomed or used to, in <ab>comp.</ab>; नीवारभागधेयोचितैः <ls>R. 1. 50</ls>, <ls n="R.">2. 25</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 54</ls>, <ls n="R. 3.">60</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 9</ls>; चन्दनोचितः <ls>Ki. 1. 34</ls>. .²4 Praiseworthy. .²5 Delightful, agreeable, pleasurable. .²6 Known, understood. .²7 Entrusted, deposited. .²8 Measured, accurate, adjusted (मित). .²9 Acceptable (ग्राह्य). .²10 Natural (स्वभावसिद्ध); उचितं च महाबाहुर्न जहौ हर्षमात्मवान् <ls>Rām. 2. 19. 37</ls>. .{@-ज्ञ@} {%n.%} Knowing what is becoming, proper or convenient.
